mediaRequirements.title: 📎 Media Requirements
mediaRequirements.description: Short & clear: Requirements for accepted content — please follow exactly.

fields.name: WHAT THE VIDEO NEEDS
fields.value:
• Server IP visible & readable on-screen: play.vanillaxtra.com
• Comments must come from different users
• Discord link **MUST** be on-screen or in your bio
• Content **MUST** be about the server
• Organic content only — no AI-generated content

fields.name: DURATION
fields.value: • Media stays up for 2 weeks, then will be removed

footer.text: Vanilla Xtra • Contact mods with questions
